title: refactor(icons): repoint ui icon consumers (#6567)
evidence:
Repoint `CloseButton`, `MessageSources`, `ResponseStatus`, and `PromptField` off the pre-RFC `icon/elements/` module onto the internal `<swc-ui-icon>` element, matching the Accordion POC. No public API changes.

- Visual change: `swc-close-button`'s cross icon now uses `<swc-ui-icon icon="cross">` a
